lines.en: I drive forward through the air.
My toes float half a block up.
I fly one lap around the field.
My ki pushes me on.

lines.zh: 气流被我压出一道白线。
lines.en: I press the air into a white streak.

lines.zh: 脚尖点地，我又浮起半格。
lines.en: My toes touch down, and I rise half a block again.
I slide past the eaves.
I strafe above your head.
The current pulls my robe taut.
I cross two blocks in a step.
I skim low over the ground.
I keep getting faster.
I hover while my ki circulates.
My third eye opens slowly.
I press my palms together.
Ki glows between my fingers.
I look down at the flagstones.
I stay still; the wind moves first.
I slowly gather my ki back.
My hem floats in the air.
I am gauging your level.
I keep even my breath quiet.
I wipe my brow.
I let my arms hang.
I stare at nothing for a moment.

lines.zh: 我在等一个必中的时机
lines.en: I wait for a sure opening.
I look down at you.
Three eyes lock onto you at once.
Your ki is too loose.
I do not plan to strike first.

lines.zh: 你抬头也只能看到我的影子
lines.en: Look up and you see only my shadow.
I take my time looking you over.
How many years have you trained?

lines.zh: 你这身板子撑不了几下
lines.en: That frame will not last long.
I open my palm for you to see.
Your eyes keep slipping away.
Easy, I have not begun.
I keep my ki within my sleeves.
You are standing too far forward.
I dip my head slightly.
I know your kind.

lines.zh: 你出手的样子我已经想到了
lines.en: I have already pictured your attack.

lines.zh: 让我看看你练到哪一步。
lines.en: Let me see how far you have trained.
I am waiting on you.
That broke through my ki.
I sway once and steady.
Blood runs from my temple.
My shoulder drops.
My third eye stings.
I give half a block.

lines.zh: 我这只眼，看得比两只准。
lines.en: My third eye sees truer than two.
A corner of my robe is torn.
My ki tumbles inside me.
I will give that one back.

lines.zh: 你举着那东西想干什么
lines.en: What do you mean to do with that?
I do not fight with props.
I only tilt my head.
I push it away with a hand.
Your intent is plain.
Such a trinket does not impress me.
My eyes do not go there.
Put it away.
Focus on the fight instead.
A cheap trick.
You blunder into my aura.
I sink my weight and hold.
I raise a knee to block you.
The pressure wave lifts your feet off the ground.
We knock with a muffled sound.
I turn to shed the force.
Hitting me is like hitting a wall.
I hold my footing.
You slide past my shoulder.
I push forward half an inch.
She hovers level with me.
We hold, one above the other.
She raises a palm to meet mine.
Two auras join into one.
We open our eyes at the same moment.
She floats at my right rear.
We trade positions.
She says my strikes are too direct.
We look down at the ground below.
Her ki runs colder than mine.
I draw it up with my ki.
I catch the falling rubble.
I hold it in my palm.
One look and I set it down.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡住飞来的碎片
lines.en: I block the flying shards.
I flick it back to the ground.
The current holds it for me.
I pick up a piece of iron.
I tuck it into my sash.
I flick it away.
I come to a stop.
My third eye opens fully.
Ki gathers in my palm.
I have found your gap.
First I close the air above.
I stop holding back.
The distance is right.
I raise a hand at you.
You are slowing down.
This should end now.
I shift my weight forward.
My ki has locked on.

lines.zh: 第三眼一睁，气就压下去。
lines.en: The third eye opens, and the ki comes down.
You cannot leave my range.
I raise my palm slowly.
Your back is showing.
I keep my height and follow you.
I see wherever you hide.
Ki light glows beneath my hand.
I am reading your landing spot.
Your jumps are half a beat slow.
I keep one shot in reserve.
My knuckles go white.
You change direction; I change angle.
I keep this shot small.
Not even a small blast is wasted.
I wait for you to leave the ground.
In the air you have nothing to push off.
I hold half a step above you.
My little ki blasts are already circling close to you.
The wind rises behind me.

lines.zh: 我快到你反应不过来了
lines.en: I am moving faster than you can answer.
I wait one more breath.
I loosen my shoulders.
I bring a palm down.
A ki beam fires from my palm.
I fire two shots in a row.
My kick finds his stomach.
An aerial combo drives him down.
A small blast bursts at his feet.

lines.zh: 他格开一发，第二发没躲过
lines.en: He blocks one; the next lands.
I close in with an elbow.
I sweep him back with a backhand.

lines.zh: 这一发擦着他的肩过去
lines.en: That shot grazes his shoulder.
I recover and hang above him.
He is driven into the dirt.
My knee cuts off his path.
I press down three tenths.
The ki in my hand has not faded.
I drop back to where I started.
I come down out of the air.
Ki spreads across the field first.
My third eye opens.
I stop one block above the ground.

lines.zh: 地面被我震出一道裂纹
lines.en: The ground cracks under my landing.
My third eye never closes.
Someone's ki is too loud.

lines.zh: 我从武道会的场边现身
lines.en: I appear at the tournament's edge.
My robe still drifts.
I straighten my back inch by inch.
The air begins to warm.
I stand without a word.
Those around take half a step back.
I place my palm on my chest.

lines.zh: 武道会的石台，我踩实了。
lines.en: I plant my feet on the tournament's stone.
I push my ki to its limit.
The field falls quiet.
I begin counting my breaths.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的袖子往上烧
lines.en: Fire climbs my sleeve.
I am knocked out of the air.
The water pins my ki down.
The blast tears my ki shield.
Something punches through my shoulder.
Spell light binds my arm.
Hunger leaves my ki channels weak.
Lightning runs along my ki.
I fall through the void.
